limits: Shared host; outside activity uncontrolled. All observations retained. Profiling and correctness elapsed times are not throughput measurements.
Build used an isolated source snapshot because another session was removing compiler feature gates in the main checkout. Those changes are excluded from this experiment.

Native fault reference is an archived Dynarmic executable rerun with policy marker 7; generated WASM probe explicitly uses 18. Native execution does not use the WASM compiler policy. Both markers are independently checked; no equal-policy claim is made.

The quiet fault probe aborted before case 0 under both 17 and 18 because its coverage checks require compiled counters. A separate diagnostics-enabled probe supplied the recorded native comparisons; production replays and timings use the diagnostics-free runtime.
An attempted native-probe relink against the old native build failed on missing newer runtime globals; no output from that failed build is treated as verification.

The additional inline-branch test was compiled after timings with diagnostics ON. It changes only test coverage; every production source file still matches implementation commit a227e2289 and frozen runtime hashes were rechecked.
WASM counter assignments are structural evidence; V8 may simplify equivalent arithmetic. No individual machine-instruction cost is inferred.
disposition: Retain policy 18 as opt-in; the completed two-panel comparison did not establish a useful repeatable speedup. Policy 17 remains the default; live deployment unchanged.

plan.hypothesis: Generic deferred instruction accounting removes runtime counter updates through straight-line code, predicated instructions, inlined calls and loops, materializing at control-flow edges and observing exact prefixes on cold exits. Compare policies 17 and 18 in the same binary.
plan.decision_rule: One reversed-order BAAB confirmation for both games, prescribed after mixed initial Sky Force pairs. Pool every observation. Require a useful roughly 3 percent mean gain with at least three of four pairs favorable in a game and no repeatable material regression in the other; otherwise retain as opt-in. No further timing expansion for this task.
